topic: Every gear of Luffy from Gear 2 to Gear 5 and the new chapter 1198 form, argued through one thesis: each gear is what Luffy built right after a loss, and each one charges a price
title: Every Gear Of Luffy Explained: From Gear 2 To Gear 6
description:
Every gear of Luffy explained in order: Gear 2, Gear 3, Gear 4 (Boundman, Tankman and Snakeman), Gear 5, and the new form from chapter 1198 that fans are calling Gear 6, though Oda hasn't named it. Each chapter shows what the gear is, the fight that made Luffy build it, and the price it charged him, with a chapter number behind every claim.

The thread through all of it is one idea: every gear is what Luffy built right after a loss. Which price do you think was the worst one?
comment: Which gear paid the worst price: Gear 2's life span warning, Gear 3's shrink, Gear 4's Haki drain, or Gear 5's attention from Imu? Pick one.

lines.text: Every gear Luffy has ever used comes with a bill, and I don't think anyone has ever added them all up.

lines.text: Start with the problem every gear exists to solve. Luffy's fruit makes him rubber, and rubber has holes.

lines.text: Here is my thesis, and this whole video hangs on it. Every gear is what Luffy built right after a loss.

lines.text: Not after a training montage. After something beat him, and he converted that defeat into a new body.

lines.text: Gear 2 came from a speed he couldn't match. Gear 3 came from a steel door he couldn't open.

shot.fallback: anime style stretching rubber arm bouncing off cannonballs in a harbor

lines.text: Gear 4 came from Haki he couldn't use without losing his rubber. Gear 5 came from losing to Kaido three times.

shot.fallback: anime style stretching rubber arm bouncing off cannonballs in a harbor

lines.text: And if that holds, the next form arrives right after his next loss, with its price named by an enemy before anyone else.

shot.fallback: anime style scales weighing steam, a shrunken child, a clock and a crown of clouds

lines.text: The prices were never the point.

shot.fallback: anime style scales weighing steam, a shrunken child, a clock and a crown of clouds

lines.text: Each one proves Luffy would rather owe the bill than lose the person in front of him.

shot.fallback: anime style scales weighing steam, a shrunken child, a clock and a crown of clouds

lines.text: And if you want the full argument about that newest form, that's my 1198 video from the week before.

shot.fallback: anime style scales weighing steam, a shrunken child, a clock and a crown of clouds

self_check.hook: Line 1 names every gear of Luffy and says each one comes with a bill; the core question (what each cost and which loss made him build it) lands by line 3.
self_check.loop: The final line points to the related 1198 video rather than looping.

published.comment: Which gear paid the worst price: Gear 2's life span warning, Gear 3's shrink, Gear 4's Haki drain, or Gear 5's attention from Imu? Pick one.
